thread:
alex_cheng: Quick async check — starting a tiny-slice rollout for feature flag `faststart` (slice: 0.5%). Post short updates here please. Plan: 30m warmup + 1h observation, automatic ramp if metrics stable.

ci-bot: deploy triggered: rollout/ff-faststart -> slice=0.5% (manifest: rollout-2026-03-17-ff). CI link: https://ci.example.com/build/8821 :rocket:

mia: Saw the first batch land on shard-3. No obvious errors in logs yet. Latency looks +6ms p50 so far.

raj_p: Observability: request error rate steady, but I'm seeing a small uptick in kv cache evictions on slice nodes (eviction-rate ~0.8%). Tagging eng-runtime to keep an eye.

sofia: From infra side: warmed 4/6 instances for the slice. I can spin two more if we want to be conservative. That will add ~12% extra headroom.

alex_cheng: @sofia please spin 2 more; better safe. I'll hold on auto-ramp unless evictions <0.5% for 15m.

mia: Quick datapoint: a handful (~4) of 502s in the first 2 minutes from shard-7; traces point at transient GPU oom retry. Retrying now.

raj_p: Thanks, mia — I'm enabling a slightly higher request timeout for the slice (from 10s -> 12s) to reduce client-visible 502s while we confirm kernel scheduling.

ci-bot: metric alert suppressed for rollout/ff-faststart: transient 502 spike acknowledged by Raj.

sofia: spun up 2 extra nodes and attached to slice. Warmup logs show models loaded and kv cache primed.

alex_cheng: New ask: can we hold on changing routing rules until the 15m check? I want to avoid dual changes.

mia: Ack. Will not change traffic rules. Current p50 latency +7ms, p95 +40ms. Error rate back to baseline after retries.

raj_p: Evictions down to 0.4% after extra nodes. No other anomalous signals. I think we can proceed to auto-ramp if everyone is +1.

sofia: +1 from infra. Nothing in host health.

mia: +1 from obs. Will keep running a focused prompt set to ensure quality doesn't regress.

alex_cheng: +1. Proceed to automatic ramp to 5% over 20m. If any alert fires, rollback to 0.5% and ping here.

ci-bot: rollout updated: slice -> 5% over 20m. Link: https://ci.example.com/rollouts/ff-faststart/3141592653

raj_p: Noted — enabling a canary-specific log sampling increase (x10) for 30m to help debug if further issues emerge.

sofia: Heads-up for follow-up: will run a short post-ramp capacity test at 15m mark to validate KV hit rates.

alex_cheng: Thanks all. If you see anything odd just ping @eng-oncall and drop a short note here. I'll close the check-in after the 60m observation window. :thumbsup:
